''Blanquiazules'' | founded = {{start date and age|df=yes|1922|8|8}} | stadium = [[Estadio Heliodoro Rodríguez López]] | capacity = 22,824{{cite web|url=http://www.clubdeportivotenerife.es/el-club/instalaciones/instalaciones-estadio-heliodoro-rodriguez-lopez|publisher=CD Tenerife|title=Instalaciones|language=es|access-date=26 May 2016|archive-date=20 June 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160620143903/http://www.clubdeportivotenerife.es/el-club/instalaciones/instalaciones-estadio-heliodoro-rodriguez-lopez|url-status=live}} | chairman = [[Felipe Miñambres]] | chrtitle = President | manager = [[Álvaro Cervera]] | mgrtitle = Head coach | league = {{Spanish football updater|Tenerife}} | season = {{Spanish football updater|Tenerife2}} | position = {{Spanish football updater|Tenerife3}} | website = {{URL|http://www.clubdeportivotenerife.es/|clubdeportivotenerife.es}} | pattern_la1 = | pattern_b1 = _tenerife2526h | pattern_ra1 = | pattern_sh1 = _tenerife2526h | pattern_so1 = _tenerife2526hl | leftarm1 = FFFFFF | body1 = FFFFFF | rightarm1 = FFFFFF | shorts1 = 0000bc | socks1 = FFFFFF | pattern_la2 = | pattern_b2 = _tenerife2526a | pattern_ra2 = | pattern_sh2 = _tenerife2526a | pattern_so2 = _tenerife2526al | leftarm2 = 882321 | body2 = 882321 | rightarm2 = 882321 | shorts2 = 882321 | socks2 = 882321 | pattern_la3 = _tenerife2526t | pattern_b3 = _tenerife2526t | pattern_ra3 = _tenerife2526t | pattern_sh3 = _tenerife2526t | pattern_so3 = _tenerife2526tl | leftarm3 = 56cacf | body3 = 56cacf | rightarm3 = 56cacf | shorts3 = 56cacf | socks3 = 56cacf | current = 2025–26 CD Tenerife season }} '''Club Deportivo Tenerife, S.A.D.''' is a [[List of football clubs in Spain|Spanish football club]] based in [[Santa Cruz de Tenerife]], [[Tenerife]], in the [[Canary Islands]]. Founded in 1922, the club plays in the {{Spanish football updater|Tenerife}}, holding home matches at the [[Estadio Heliodoro Rodríguez López]], with a 22,824-seat capacity. The traditional home colours are white shirts and blue shorts. Tenerife has a history playing in the top flight of [[La Liga]]. They have been promoted to the top tier on four occasions, including a 10-year stint from [[1989–90 La Liga|1989]] to [[1998–99 La Liga|1999]]. The club managed to finish as high as fifth in the league table on two occasions during that period, which qualified them for the first round of the [[UEFA Cup]]. They most recently played in La Liga in the [[2009–10 La Liga|2009–10]] season. Being based in the Canary archipelago off the Atlantic coast of Africa, while playing its away games on the Spanish mainland, both the club and rival [[UD Las Palmas|Las Palmas]] from [[Gran Canaria]] are two of the most geographically isolated professional clubs. Tenerife and Las Palmas contest the [[Canary Islands derby]]."}}
